title: Beyond Correctness: Validity-Oriented Evaluation of Biomedical LLM Judges
abstract: arXiv:2608.29127v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a scalable, validity-oriented pipeline for evaluating biomedical LLM judges when high-quality human judgments are scarce. First, we augment existing human-labelled biomedical benchmarks with deterministic, metric-grounded mutations that produce auditable preference pairs. Second, we evaluate judges beyond aggregate correctness using three deployment-relevant dimensions: correctness against metric-derived gold labels, robustness under repeated stochastic sampling, and compliance with the requested output format. translated_title: 超越正确性：面向有效性的生物医学LLM裁判评估
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种可扩展的、面向有效性的评估流程，用于在高质量人工判断稀缺的情况下评估生物医学LLM裁判。首先，我们通过确定性的、基于度量的变异来增强现有的人工标注生物医学基准，从而生成可审计的偏好对。其次，我们从三个与部署相关的维度对裁判进行超越总体正确性的评估：对照度量衍生金标准标签的正确性、重复随机采样下的稳健性，以及对所要求输出格式的遵循度。我们使用该流程评估了Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct在四种模式下的表现：（1）基础模式，直接使用指令模型；（2）SFT，仅进行基于蒸馏的监督微调；（3）RL，仅进行基于GRPO的强化学习；（4）SFT→RL，先SFT后RL。基础模式和单阶段模式在结构化医学判别任务（如PICO提取和临床计算）上表现不佳，而SFT→RL……
tldr: 提出了一种在高质量人工判断稀缺时评估生物医学LLM裁判的可扩展有效性导向流程，通过基于度量的变异生成可审计的偏好对，并从正确性、稳健性和格式合规性三个维度评估，发现SFT与RL结合的模式在结构化医学判别任务上优于基础和单阶段模式。
en_tdlr: Proposes a scalable validity-oriented pipeline for evaluating biomedical LLM judges when high-quality human judgments are scarce, using deterministic metric-grounded mutations to create auditable preference pairs and assessing correctness, robustness, and format compliance, showing that the combined SFT→RL regime outperforms base and single-stage regimes on structured medical discrimination tasks.
